name: closable-tabs
title: Closable tabs
description: Tabs you can close and add: a close button on each tab, a plus at the end, and a sensible tab chosen after closing.
docs: Pass tabs (id, label, icon, closable, dirty), value and onValueChange, and render TabsContent panels as children. Each tab has a close button named Close <label>; a middle click or Delete on a tab asks for it to close as well. onClose(id) is only a request: nothing closes until you remove the tab from tabs, so you can show a confirmation first. When the selected tab goes, the nearest neighbour (to its right, else to its left) is selected through onValueChange and takes focus. A dirty tab shows a dot instead of the close button until hover or focus and says unsaved changes in its name. onAdd adds the plus button; at maxTabs it stays focusable, dimmed, and explains why. A tab with closable false is pinned: it has no close button, and a small pin stands where the button would be so every tab keeps the same room. Overflow scrolls behind fade edges with the selected tab kept in view; the arrows appear where there is a hover, and touch swipes. If you confirm in a dialog, focus is put on the neighbour tab after the dialog has closed; when the person keeps the tab, return focus to it in the dialog's onCloseAutoFocus.
